jobs.description:
Vacaturebeschrijving
   IntroJoin as a Food Machine Operator in Lopik! Work with modern cheese production lines, earn €16.92-€24.26 gross per hour, and build your career in a friendly environment.
Dit ga je doenAre you looking for a new step in food production and do you have experience as a machine operator? In Lopik, you will work as a Food Machine Operator with a focus on cheese production. Your main job is to operate, monitor, and optimize modern production lines that make smoked and processed cheeses for customers around the world. You make sure every product meets the highest standards for quality and food safety, and you help your team keep the process running smoothly.
 On a typical day, you will set and adjust technical parameters like temperature, pressure, and mixing times, making sure each batch is perfect. You check critical control points (HACCP), solve mechanical and process issues, and support less experienced operators with your knowledge. The work is a mix of hands-on technical tasks and teamwork - you are a key link between production, quality, and technical departments. You will work in shifts, so flexibility is important. Basic English skills (A2-B1) are enough for this job - you just need to understand instructions and communicate with your team.
 Why apply? You will join a stable company with modern equipment and a friendly work environment. Here, you can grow your skills, follow trainings, and build a real career in food technology. Your work is valued, and you will be part of a company that cares for quality, safety, and the future.
 Dit breng je mee - Experience as a process or machine operator in the food industry (dairy or cheese is a plus)
 - MBO-3 or MBO-4 diploma in Process Technology, Food Technology, Mechanical Engineering, or similar
 - Good understanding of production processes and basic automation
 - Knowledge of HACCP and food safety standards
 - Flexible to work in shifts and take responsibility for your area Basic Engl

jobs.description:
Vacaturebeschrijving
   IntroWork as a Food Machine Operator in Lopik, specializing in cheese production. Full-time, €16.92-€24.26 gross/hour depending on experience. Join a modern food processing environment and help create top-quality cheese products.
Dit ga je doenAre you experienced in food production and passionate about process optimization? As a Food Machine Operator in Lopik, you will be hands-on with the technical side of cheese production. Your main focus will be operating and controlling advanced production lines to ensure product quality and safety every day. You will set and monitor process parameters like temperature, pressure, and mixing times, ensuring the right recipe every time. If you have experience with multi vacuum machines, that's a plus-these are used for making cheese rolls.

You'll keep an eye on critical control points (HACCP), troubleshoot technical issues, and perform in-process quality checks. You'll also coordinate with technical services when complex repairs are needed and help less experienced colleagues learn the ropes. Your work helps ensure that our cheese products meet the highest standards for food safety and taste. For this position, you need to understand and communicate in simple English at work. Language skills at A2-B1 (pre-intermediate) level are required.
 This is a great opportunity if you enjoy taking responsibility, solving problems, and want to contribute to continuous improvement in a leading food production environment. You'll be part of a company focused on innovation, with a future-oriented approach and investment in its people. Apply now to join a professional team and grow your skills in an international setting!

Good work!Over de functieAs a reach truck driver, you are responsible for safely transporting and storing pallets containing a variety of products such as snacks, sauces, and alcoholic beverages. You work accurately, keep an eye on quality, and immediately report any irregularities.
Your main tasks include:
Moving, storing, and preparing goods within the warehouse
Loading and unloading pallets safely and efficiently
Checking incoming and outgoing goods for accuracy and quality
Keeping your workspace clean and organized

You will work 5 days per week on a rotating schedule from Monday to Sunday, with two days off per week.
Working hours (two shifts):
05:00 – 14:00
14:15 – 23:15

Sustainability and innovation are at the heart of the company. Working here means joining a professional, dynamic environment with real opportunities to grow and develop your career.
